---
title: "SupMultiviewShared — stopping rule and initialisation"
jupyter: python3
---

Two comparisons on the same data and model, each varying one training choice
while holding everything else fixed:

1. **Convergence criterion** — `elbo_min`, `elbo_snr`, `grad_norm` for global
   training. Local inference uses the same base settings for every run, so only
   the global stopping rule differs.
2. **Initialisation** — default guide initialisation vs. SVD of the stacked views.

The VIPER (SupMultiviewDecomp) version of the convergence comparison is in
`sim/archive/python_integration_2026-06.qmd`.

## Setup

```{python}
import os
import sys

os.environ["R_HOME"] = "/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources"

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import torch
import pyro
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from run_methods import (
```

## Settings

```{python}
MODEL_TYPE = "shared"
DATA_ROOT  = "~/multiomic_integration/sim/data"

rep_config = {
    "n": 500, "p_l": 1000, "snr_x": 2, "snr_y": 2,
    "rep": 2, "sparsity": 0.25, "k_delta": 10,
}

DEVICE              = torch.device("cpu")
N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES = 200

train_config = {
    "eta":                   0.25,
    "delta":                 1e-16,
    "t":                     0.1,
    "num_particles":         1,
    "minibatch_fraction":    0.15,
    "min_epochs":            200,
    "max_epochs":            500,
    "convergence_criterion": "elbo_snr",
    "window":                50,
    "snr_threshold":         5,
}

# Stopping-rule settings for the convergence comparison
CRITERIA = ["elbo_min", "elbo_snr", "grad_norm"]
CRITERION_SETTINGS = {"window": 50, "snr_threshold": 0.1, "grad_norm_tol": 1e-3}
```

## Load and process data

```{python}
cond_dir = (f"n{rep_config['n']}p{rep_config['p_l']}"
            f"_snr{rep_config['snr_x']}.{rep_config['snr_y']}"
            f"_sparse{rep_config['sparsity']}")

def rds_path(split):
    return os.path.expanduser(f"{DATA_ROOT}/multi_view_shared/k.5/{split}/{cond_dir}/"
                              f"sim_data_shared_rep{rep_config['rep']}.rds")

sim_data      = load_rds(rds_path("train"))
sim_data_test = load_rds(rds_path("test"))
train_subset, test_subset, data_package = process_data(
    sim_data, sim_data_test, training_split=False, training_size=0.8, seed=123,
    model_type=MODEL_TYPE,
)
K_FIT = int(sim_data["K"]) + rep_config["k_delta"]
model_config = {"k": K_FIT, "dense_model": False}
n_train = len(train_subset)
```

```{python}
def fit_and_evaluate(global_config, svd_init=False):
    """Global training with global_config, local inference with train_config,
    then evaluation. Returns a dict of the fitted model, timings and metrics."""
    pyro.clear_param_store()
    fm, train_handler, global_state = train_model(
        model_config, global_config, train_subset,
        model_type=MODEL_TYPE, write=False, device=DEVICE, svd_init=svd_init)
    fm, test_handler, local_state = train_model_locally(
        fm, train_config, test_subset, model_type=MODEL_TYPE, device=DEVICE)
    eval_table, _, _, _ = evaluate_fitted_model(
        rep_config, data_package, train_handler, test_handler,
        global_state, local_state, N_POSTERIOR_SAMPLES, model_type=MODEL_TYPE)
    return {
        "model":        fm,
        "epochs":       fm.total_epochs,
        "time_s":       global_state["inference_time"] + global_state["svd_time"],
        "loss_history": fm.loss_history,
        "var_history":  fm.var_param_convergence_history,
        "eval_table":   eval_table,
    }

def summary_row(res):
    tbl = res["eval_table"]
    return {
        "epochs":               res["epochs"],
        "time_s":               round(res["time_s"], 1),
        "joint_rse":            tbl["joint_rse"].mean(),
        "test_rse":             tbl["test_rse"].mean(),
        "outcome_mse":          tbl["outcome_mse"].iloc[0],
        "outcome_95p_coverage": tbl["outcome_95p_coverage"].iloc[0],
    }
```

## Convergence criterion comparison

```{python}
cc_results = {
    criterion: fit_and_evaluate({**train_config, **CRITERION_SETTINGS,
                                 "convergence_criterion": criterion})
    for criterion in CRITERIA
}
cc_summary = pd.DataFrame({c: summary_row(r) for c, r in cc_results.items()}).T
cc_summary
```

```{python}
palette = {"elbo_min": "steelblue", "elbo_snr": "darkorange", "grad_norm": "seagreen"}

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for criterion, res in cc_results.items():
    hist = np.array(res["loss_history"]) / n_train
    for ax in axes:
        ax.plot(np.arange(1, len(hist) + 1), hist, label=criterion,
                color=palette[criterion], alpha=0.85)
axes[0].set_title("Neg-ELBO per datum — full history")
axes[1].set_title("Neg-ELBO per datum — first 200 epochs")
axes[1].set_xlim(0, 200)
for ax in axes:
    ax.set(xlabel="Epoch", ylabel="Neg-ELBO / n")
    ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
cols = list(cc_summary.columns)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(cols), figsize=(4 * len(cols), 4))
for ax, col in zip(axes, cols):
    ax.bar(cc_summary.index, cc_summary[col].astype(float),
           color=[palette[c] for c in cc_summary.index])
    ax.set_title(col)
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=15)
plt.suptitle("SupMultiviewShared — convergence criterion comparison", y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
for criterion, res in cc_results.items():
    hist = np.array(res["var_history"])
    ax.plot(np.arange(1, len(hist) + 1), hist, label=criterion,
            color=palette[criterion], alpha=0.85)
ax.set(xlabel="Epoch", ylabel="Mean param-norm change",
       title="Variational parameter convergence history")
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Initialisation: default vs. SVD

```{python}
init_results = {
    "default": fit_and_evaluate(train_config, svd_init=False),
    "svd":     fit_and_evaluate(train_config, svd_init=True),
}
pd.DataFrame({name: summary_row(r) for name, r in init_results.items()}).T
```

```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3))
for name, res in init_results.items():
    ax.plot([l / n_train for l in res["loss_history"]], label=name, alpha=0.8)
ax.set(xlabel="Epoch", ylabel="Neg-ELBO per datum",
       title=f"SVD vs default init  (N={rep_config['n']}, P={rep_config['p_l']}, K={K_FIT})")
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
